acceptanceCriteria: #1021-1: for a set of tests and a revision pair, a read lists each test as reusable or must-run with the reason.
#1021-2: any change to a fingerprint input makes the result must-run.
#1021-3: a missing or unqualified prior result fails closed as must-run.
#1021-4: the redundancy report gives minutes re-run versus reusable, split into exact and same-file-content matches.
#1021-5: both outputs are read-only and bounded, with a compact summary form.
#1024-1: a change to a cited or shared-code path returns STALE and names the path.
#1024-2: only changes outside the declared reach return FRESH.
#1024-3: a resolution error is a distinct outcome, never FRESH.
#1024-4: shared-code patterns are configured in the repository, not hard-coded.
#1024-5: the freshness result can serve as an additional reuse condition for passing-result reuse.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1021 and #1024 (filed 2026-10-17 by the owner). #1021: record a fingerprint (application revision, test-suite revision, test-file digest, config digest, selected project) with each retained passing result; a read lists selected tests as reusable or must-run with a reason; a redundancy report gives test-minutes by category and the share that re-ran an already-passing test (exact versus same-file-content matches). #1024: 'evidence fresh OLD NEW' over a declared reach (cited files plus repository-configured shared-code patterns) returns FRESH, STALE naming the deciding paths, or a distinct resolution-error outcome; usable as an extra reuse condition for #1021. Read-only, bounded, compact summary form.
title: Passing-result reuse at an identical fingerprint, redundancy report, and rebase evidence freshness (GitHub #1021, #1024)
